name: ecommerce-backend
description: E-commerce backend running on Cloudflare Workers

scripts.deploy:prod: npm --prefix ../frontend run build && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.seed: wrangler d1 execute ecommerce --local --file=./migrations/0002_seed_books.sql && wrangler d1 execute ecommerce --local --file=./migrations/0003_seed_more_books.sql
scripts.seed:remote: wrangler d1 execute ecommerce --remote --file=./migrations/0002_seed_books.sql && wrangler d1 execute ecommerce --remote --file=./migrations/0003_seed_more_books.sql
